text:
Jordan (Sales): FYI incoming from Nimbus Health — they want a proposal: reserved capacity + flexible overage credits. asking for a blended effective rate to present to their CFO.
Maya (PM): can you paste the usage profile? token mix, peak qps, model family?
Jordan (Sales): sent a quick summary: 70% embeddings (512-d), 30% chat generation (open-llm-family), avg seq 180 tokens, monthly committed tokens ~1.8B, spikes for reports up to 5x. they want ability to burst without a big premium.
Sam (Eng): burst is doable if we reserve some headroom but latency SLOs degrade when oversubscribe. need to know whether they require hard SLA for bursts.
Jordan (Sales): Nimbus asked for SLA for core workflows (report gen). can accept best-effort for low-priority background.
Anya (C-Success): they also need audit logs + IP allowlist. that pushes them to Dedicated or Private. confirm which is ok for their compliance.
Lee (Finance): quick flags: blended pricing complicates invoicing and revenue recognition. recommend min commit term 12mo and a floor for effective rate calculation.
Maya (PM): propose two options to present:
- Option A: Reserved commit (1.8B/mo) at commit_rate, with burst credits purchased at a fixed discounted overage rate; SLA for core workflows guaranteed on reserved capacity.
- Option B: Blended pool: combine commit + estimated burst into a blended effective rate with a reconciliation each quarter (true-up).
Sam (Eng): technical notes: Option A simpler for routing and fallback (route core to reserved pool, burst -> best-effort cluster). Option B requires admission control + dynamic routing and more telemetry.
Jordan (Sales): Nimbus prefers Option B if we can keep blended rate within 10% of commit-only price. they also asked about a trial lower-term pilot (3 mo) to validate.
Lee (Finance): pilot ok but we need a minimum guaranteed commit for pilot (e.g., 30% of monthly) and explicit credit memo rules for overages.
Maya (PM): tradeoffs captured. need product decision: do we treat this as a pricing-exception (manual deal) or build a formal "blended-commit" product offering?
pricing-bot: reminder: add PRD link to pricing-exceptions template -> /docs/pricing-exceptions-template (auto)
Maya (PM): my recommendation: triage as a high-priority sales intake -> create backlog epic "blended-commit pilot - enterprise". scope for short term: manual SOW + playbook (sales + finance + eng runbook). medium term: evaluate productizing if we see 3+ similar deals.
Sam (Eng): for the pilot we can support via Dedicated + routing rules. will need an ops runbook: capacity cushion, KV cache pinning for report gen, and quantization profile spec. ETA for runbook: 2 weeks.
Anya (C-Success): I'll own onboarding + compliance checklist for Nimbus. need to sync on IP allowlist + audit retention (90 vs 365 days).
Jordan (Sales): Nimbus wants pricing by EOD Friday. pls confirm owners so I can promise timelines.
Maya (PM): owners: Maya (PM) - overall, Sam (Eng) - runbook & capacity config, Lee (Finance) - billing template & legal playbook, Anya (C-Success) - onboarding/compliance. Jordan to coordinate with customer.
Lee (Finance): I'll draft the invoice template and reconciliation terms. target first draft within 48h.
Maya (PM): next steps: 1) create epic and ticket in product backlog (I will). 2) Sam to deliver ops runbook in 2w. 3) Lee to share billing template in 48h. 4) Anya to confirm compliance items by EOD tomorrow. 5) Jordan to present Option A/B to Nimbus by Friday.
Jordan (Sales): noted. thanks team. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): small code snippet for effective rate calc to include in proposal:
```
effective_rate = (commit_units * commit_rate + burst_units * burst_rate) / total_units
```
Maya (PM): capture acceptance criteria for pilot:
- Core workflow latency within SLO (p95 <= target) on reserved capacity
- Successful burst up to 3x baseline for report jobs with <10% error increase
- Billing reconciliation runs and agrees within 2% at quarter end
If pilot passes, productize conversation.
Jordan (Sales): all set, creating customer-facing slide deck and will link here when ready.
Anya (C-Success): ping me when deck is ready, will prep onboarding timeline.
Maya (PM): I'll create the epic: prod backlog -> tags: pricing-exception, pilot, enterprise, owners: @Sam @Lee @Anya. deadline for epic creation: today EOD.
Jordan (Sales): thanks everyone.
